Chartist v1.5.0
https://gionkunz.github.io/chartist-js/

Vendored locally (not loaded from a CDN) so the app has no runtime
dependency on a third-party host. Unmodified upstream ESM build
(`dist/index.js` from the npm package), plus its companion stylesheet
(`dist/index.css`). Used by the Trajectory chart (src/views/
trajectory-view.js) for the drop/windage/velocity/etc.-vs-distance plot.

permissive and GPL-compatible.
